functions.name: ov01_021EA73C

struct_accesses.meaning: ptr from Heap_Alloc(4, count1*4); filled by FS_ReadFile
ptr from Heap_Alloc(4, count0*4); filled by FS_ReadFile

functions.notes: Stack frame 0x4c: FSFile at sp+4 (sizeof(FSFile)=0x48), u16 header[2] at sp+0. File format: reads 2 bytes into sp+2 (count for array0), then 2 bytes into sp+0 (count for array1); allocates count*4 bytes for each, reads both arrays, closes file. Asserts every FS_ReadFile >= 0 and FS_OpenFile success (assert-only branch on open failure, still pops normally). HEAP_ID 4 hardcoded. Watch the dual-epilogue (early-exit at _021EA7D8 after assert) — likely GF_AssertFail then return shape.

risks: All exports are called only from still-asm overlays (asm/overlay_01_021F3610.s, asm/overlay_01_021FB878.s) — no existing C header constrains signatures, so the new header is the source of truth; get the u16*-out params right for future IPA
ov01_021EA73C has duplicated epilogue (assert path at _021EA7D8) — match via early return after GF_ASSERT-style call, not fallthrough
FSFile local (0x48 bytes at sp+4) plus a separate u16[2] at sp+0 — declaration order of locals matters for the 0x4c frame layout
GF_ASSERT(ptr != NULL) after each Heap_Alloc uses the bne-skip idiom; use GF_ASSERT macro, not explicit if
Hardcoded heap ID 4 — use the enum HeapID constant for value 4, codegen identical
No rodata/data/bss in this file; no save_arrays.c involvement
notes: Tiny self-contained file-backed lookup-table module (load a 2-array binary file by path, query u16 entries, free). All thumb, ~0x100 bytes total. Callers: ov01_021FB878.s creates it via ov01_021EA724, sprintf's a filename (ov01_02209A88/ov01_02209AB4 format strings) and loads with ov01_021EA73C, frees via ov01_021EA7E0; ov01_021F3610.s queries via ov01_021EA7F8/ov01_021EA804/ov01_021EA81C during 3D model rendering. C file function order must follow asm order: 724, 73C, 7E0, 7F8, 804, 81C.
